name: Banh mi
summary: Banh mi is a light baguette with pâté, mayonnaise, pickles, herbs, and usually a protein. The bread should crackle. The filling should not be only meat.
origin: A colonial-era loaf adapted across the country. Hoi An’s versions are famous; every city has a morning stall. In Da Nang it is the breakfast you eat standing up, on the way to the beach or the Hoi An road.
howToEat: Eat it the morning it is baked. Point at the fillings if the stall has several.
A stall with a queue of office workers is a better sign than a picture menu in five languages.
priceBand: One of the cheapest full meals in the country.
seoDescription: What goes in a banh mi, and how to pick a stall.
